source: A lightweight framework for building reliable developer tools.
target: 一个用于构建可靠开发者工具的轻量级框架。

source: Install the package with npm install before continuing.
target: 继续操作前，请使用 npm install 安装软件包。

source: The CLI reads configuration from config.json.
target: CLI 从 config.json 读取配置。

source: This SDK supports Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
target: 此 SDK 支持 Node.js、TypeScript 和 JavaScript。

source: Clone the repository and switch to the main Branch.
target: 克隆仓库并切换到 main Branch（分支）。

source: The API returns JSON over HTTPS.
target: 该 API 通过 HTTPS 返回 JSON。

source: Docker is optional for local development.
target: 本地开发可选择使用 Docker。

source: Kubernetes deployment examples live in ./deploy.
target: Kubernetes 部署示例位于 ./deploy。

source: Run the test suite before opening a Pull Request.
target: 发起 Pull Request（拉取请求）前，请运行测试套件。

source: GitHub Actions verifies every Commit.
target: GitHub Actions 会验证每个 Commit（提交）。

source: Version v2.4.1 requires Python 3.12 or later.
target: 版本 v2.4.1 需要 Python 3.12 或更高版本。

source: Read the migration guide at https://example.com/migrate.
target: 请阅读 https://example.com/migrate 上的迁移指南。

source: The React example uses the useMemo hook.
target: React 示例使用 useMemo Hook。

source: Set --port to choose a different HTTP port.
target: 设置 --port 可选择其他 HTTP 端口。

source: Do not commit secrets to the repository.
target: 不要将密钥提交到仓库。

source: The default Workflow runs on Linux and Windows.
target: 默认 Workflow（工作流）在 Linux 和 Windows 上运行。

source: Use SSH when HTTPS authentication is unavailable.
target: 无法使用 HTTPS 身份验证时，请使用 SSH。

source: The server exposes a health check endpoint.
target: 服务器提供健康检查端点。

source: Rust support is experimental and may change.
target: Rust 支持仍处于实验阶段，可能发生变化。

source: The package follows semantic versioning.
target: 该软件包遵循语义化版本规范。

source: Copy .env.example to .env and update the values.
target: 将 .env.example 复制为 .env，然后更新其中的值。

source: The browser bundle does not include a runtime dependency.
target: 浏览器构建产物不包含运行时依赖。

source: See CONTRIBUTING.md for the development process.
target: 开发流程请参阅 CONTRIBUTING.md。

source: Release builds include a SHA-256 checksum.
target: Release（版本发布）构建产物包含 SHA-256 校验值。

source: The application crashes when the API returns an empty array.
target: 当 API 返回空数组时，应用会崩溃。

source: Steps to reproduce the timeout on Windows.
target: 在 Windows 上复现超时问题的步骤。

source: The error started after upgrading to v3.2.0.
target: 升级到 v3.2.0 后开始出现此错误。

source: Expected the CLI to preserve the output directory.
target: 预期 CLI 保留输出目录。

source: Actual behavior deletes the generated JSON file.
target: 实际行为会删除生成的 JSON 文件。

source: This Issue only occurs with Docker Desktop.
target: 此 Issue（议题）仅在 Docker Desktop 中出现。

source: The Runner cannot find ./scripts/build.sh.
target: Runner（执行器）找不到 ./scripts/build.sh。

source: GitHub Actions reports a permission denied error.
target: GitHub Actions 报告权限被拒绝错误。

source: The response body contains malformed UTF-8.
target: 响应正文包含格式错误的 UTF-8。

source: Please attach a minimal reproduction repository.
target: 请附上最小可复现仓库。

source: The cache is not invalidated after a new Commit.
target: 新建 Commit（提交）后缓存未失效。

source: The Branch protection rule blocks the bot account.
target: Branch（分支）保护规则阻止了机器人账号。

source: The React component renders twice in development.
target: React 组件在开发环境中渲染两次。

source: The Python client sends an incorrect Content-Type header.
target: Python 客户端发送了错误的 Content-Type 标头。

source: The URL is encoded twice before the request is sent.
target: 发送请求前，URL 被重复编码。

source: The migration changes the public API unexpectedly.
target: 此次迁移意外更改了公共 API。

source: The process exits with code 137 under load.
target: 进程在高负载下以代码 137 退出。

source: The YAML parser rejects a valid multiline value.
target: YAML 解析器拒绝了有效的多行值。

source: The modal loses focus when pressing Escape.
target: 按下 Escape 时，对话框会丢失焦点。

source: The dark theme has insufficient color contrast.
target: 深色主题的颜色对比度不足。

source: The service worker stops after 30 seconds.
target: Service Worker 会在 30 秒后停止。

source: The request retries forever without backoff.
target: 请求会在没有退避策略的情况下无限重试。

source: Commit 7f3a9bc introduced the regression.
target: Commit（提交）7f3a9bc 引入了此回归。

source: Closing and reopening the tab fixes the problem temporarily.
target: 关闭并重新打开标签页可以暂时解决此问题。

source: This Pull Request fixes the authentication race condition.
target: 此 Pull Request（拉取请求）修复了身份验证竞态条件。

source: No public API behavior changes in this patch.
target: 此补丁不会改变公共 API 的行为。

source: The new test fails before the fix and passes afterward.
target: 新增测试在修复前失败，修复后通过。

source: Please rebase this Branch onto main.
target: 请将此 Branch（分支）变基到 main。

source: The Workflow now uploads coverage reports.
target: 该 Workflow（工作流）现在会上传覆盖率报告。

source: This Commit removes an unused dependency.
target: 此 Commit（提交）移除了未使用的依赖。

source: The implementation preserves backward compatibility.
target: 此实现保持向后兼容。

source: Review the security impact before merging.
target: 合并前请审查安全影响。

source: The Docker image is now built for arm64.
target: Docker 镜像现在会为 arm64 构建。

source: The CLI error message includes the invalid path.
target: CLI 错误消息现在会包含无效路径。

source: The API timeout is configurable with --timeout.
target: API 超时时间可通过 --timeout 配置。

source: The React hook no longer updates after unmount.
target: React Hook 在卸载后不再更新。

source: This refactor reduces bundle size by 18 percent.
target: 此次重构将构建包体积减少了 18%。

source: The JSON schema rejects unknown properties.
target: JSON Schema 会拒绝未知属性。

source: Add keyboard navigation to the settings panel.
target: 为设置面板添加键盘导航。

source: The change respects prefers-reduced-motion.
target: 此更改遵守 prefers-reduced-motion 设置。

source: Links and heading anchors remain unchanged.
target: 链接和标题锚点保持不变。

source: The service worker stores secrets in trusted storage.
target: Service Worker 将密钥保存在受信任存储中。

source: The generated HTML is written through textContent.
target: 生成的 HTML 内容通过 textContent 写入。

source: The request batch is limited to 6000 characters.
target: 每个请求批次最多包含 6000 个字符。

source: The parser rejects duplicate translation IDs.
target: 解析器会拒绝重复的翻译 IDs。

source: The local engine processes paragraphs sequentially.
target: 本地引擎会串行处理段落。

source: The extension requests provider permission only when enabled.
target: 扩展仅在启用服务商时申请相应权限。

source: The fallback keeps the original text visible.
target: 回退处理会保留并显示原文。

source: How should we name the next stable Release?
target: 下一个稳定 Release（版本发布）应该如何命名？

source: I prefer keeping API names in English.
target: 我倾向于保留英文 API 名称。

source: Would a bilingual mode help new contributors?
target: 双语模式是否有助于新贡献者？

source: The current translation of Runner is ambiguous.
target: 当前对 Runner（执行器）的翻译存在歧义。

source: Please share feedback from Chinese developers.
target: 请分享中国开发者的反馈。

source: A community glossary could improve consistency.
target: 社区术语表可以提高一致性。

source: Should Fork be translated on first use only?
target: Fork（派生）是否应该只在首次出现时翻译？

source: The browser language pack works offline after download.
target: 浏览器语言包下载后可以离线工作。

source: We should not cache private Issue content.
target: 我们不应缓存私有 Issue（议题）内容。

source: The local model is shared across websites by the browser.
target: 本地模型由浏览器在不同网站之间共享。

source: How do we explain the first download clearly?
target: 如何清楚说明首次下载过程？

source: The popup should show whether translation is ready.
target: 弹出窗口应显示翻译是否已就绪。

source: Users should be able to verify every translated paragraph.
target: 用户应能核验每个已翻译段落。

source: Do we need support for Firefox in v1.0.0?
target: v1.0.0 是否需要支持 Firefox？

source: The extension must remain useful without an API Key.
target: 扩展在没有 API Key 时也必须保持实用。

source: Enhanced translation should never activate automatically.
target: 增强翻译绝不能自动启用。

source: Which terms should remain in English?
target: 哪些术语应该保留英文？

source: The default interface should use Simplified Chinese.
target: 默认界面应使用简体中文。

source: A single toggle is easier for first-time users.
target: 单个切换按钮对首次使用者更友好。

source: The translation must not change code examples.
target: 翻译不得更改代码示例。

source: Can we preserve the current scroll position?
target: 能否保持当前滚动位置？

source: The color system should blend into GitHub.
target: 配色系统应自然融入 GitHub。

source: Privacy matters more than long-term translation history.
target: 隐私比长期翻译历史更重要。

source: Let's document the quality gate before launch.
target: 我们应在发布前记录质量门禁。

source: This Release adds local English to Chinese translation.
target: 此 Release（版本发布）新增本地英译中功能。

source: The browser downloads the language pack on first use.
target: 浏览器会在首次使用时下载语言包。

source: Fixed a crash when switching GitHub pages.
target: 修复切换 GitHub 页面时发生的崩溃。

source: Improved translation quality for GitHub Actions terms.
target: 提升 GitHub Actions 术语的翻译质量。

source: Added optional OpenAI enhanced translation.
target: 新增可选的 OpenAI 增强翻译。

source: Added optional Gemini enhanced translation.
target: 新增可选的 Gemini 增强翻译。

source: Added optional DeepSeek enhanced translation.
target: 新增可选的 DeepSeek 增强翻译。

source: API Keys are isolated from GitHub content scripts.
target: API Key 与 GitHub 内容脚本相互隔离。

source: Translation output can no longer inject HTML.
target: 翻译输出不再能够注入 HTML。

source: Code blocks and Diff views are excluded.
target: 代码块和 Diff 视图已被排除。

source: The bilingual view now preserves heading anchors.
target: 双语视图现在会保留标题锚点。

source: Added keyboard focus styles to every control.
target: 为所有控件新增键盘焦点样式。

source: Reduced the extension ZIP below 250 KB.
target: 将扩展 ZIP 体积缩减到 250 KB 以下。

source: The extension no longer stores translated paragraphs.
target: 扩展不再存储已翻译段落。

source: Fixed duplicated comments after dynamic navigation.
target: 修复动态导航后评论重复的问题。

source: Improved dark theme contrast and spacing.
target: 改进深色主题的对比度与间距。

source: Added support for Release notes and comments.
target: 新增对 Release（版本发布）说明和评论的支持。

source: Invalid placeholders now fall back to the original text.
target: 占位符无效时现在会回退到原文。

source: The local queue can be cancelled on route changes.
target: 路由变化时现在可以取消本地翻译队列。

source: Provider requests are limited to 20 paragraphs.
target: 服务商请求限制为最多 20 个段落。

source: Updated the default model to gpt-5.6-terra.
target: 将默认模型更新为 gpt-5.6-terra。

source: The SHA-256 file verifies the downloaded archive.
target: SHA-256 文件可用于验证下载的压缩包。

source: Minimum supported Chrome version is 138.
target: 最低支持的 Chrome 版本为 138。

source: See SECURITY.md for vulnerability reporting.
target: 漏洞报告方式请参阅 SECURITY.md。
